sources.query: SELECT CCID, JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, PERIOD_NUM, PERIOD_YEAR, SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, JE_SOURCE, JE_CATEGORY, FUND_VALUE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, D_C_INDICATOR, AMOUNT, CREATED_ON_DT, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS

/* NOTE: This workflow runs the SAME mapping across FOUR reusable session tasks (HHS_SDE_ORA_GTASActivityBalanceFact_FDA/_PSC/_CDC/_IHS), each reading a DIFFERENT physical partition of FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES (P2/P23/P1/P43) filtered by its own $$GTAS_FISCAL_YR_<LEDGER>_EXT mapping variable, all loading into the SAME target W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS. $[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_FDA_EXT], $[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_PSC_EXT], $[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_CDC_EXT], $[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_IHS_EXT] are DataOps dataflow parameters substituting for those four Informatica mapping variables; they are currently PLACEHOLDERS (default 0, matching no real PERIOD_YEAR) and must be corrected with the real per-ledger fiscal-year lists before results are trusted — same caveat pattern as $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] below. */
/* NOTE: $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] is a DataOps dataflow parameter substituting for the Informatica mapping variable $$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID; it is currently set to a placeholder value (0) and must be corrected with the real DATASOURCE_NUM_ID before results are trusted. */
/* NOTE: Oracle PARTITION(P2/P23/P1/P43) hints were REMOVED from the four CTEs below. The DevContainer's FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES is an unpartitioned 10-row stub table (confirmed via ORA-14501 'object is not partitioned' on first build attempt, 2026-08-19) - it does not mirror production's physical partition scheme. Each CTE now reads the full stub table filtered only by its fiscal-year parameter, so in THIS environment the four CTEs cannot actually distinguish which ledger a row belongs to the way production's partitions would; this is an environment-fidelity gap, not a logic change, and must be revisited once a properly partitioned or ledger-tagged source is available. */
WITH fda AS (
  SELECT F.CCID, F.JE_HEADER_ID, F.JE_LINE_NUM, F.PERIOD_NUM, F.PERIOD_YEAR, F.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, F.JE_SOURCE, F.JE_CATEGORY, F.FUND_VALUE, F.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, F.D_C_INDICATOR, F.AMOUNT, F.CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT, $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' THEN NVL(HCA.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' THEN NVL(APS.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'M' THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'O' AND (LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 OR (F.JE_SOURCE = 'Year End Close' AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 7)) THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'B' THEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID || F.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT
      ELSE NULL
    END AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID
  FROM FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES F
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, CUST_ACCOUNT_ID FROM apps.HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) HCA ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, VENDOR_ID FROM apps.AP_SUPPLIERS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) APS ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = APS.VENDOR_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE4 FROM apps.GL_JE_LINES WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) IN (4, 7)) GJL ON F.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID AND F.JE_LINE_NUM = GJL.JE_LINE_NUM
  WHERE F.PERIOD_YEAR IN ($[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_FDA_EXT])
),
psc AS (
  SELECT F.CCID, F.JE_HEADER_ID, F.JE_LINE_NUM, F.PERIOD_NUM, F.PERIOD_YEAR, F.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, F.JE_SOURCE, F.JE_CATEGORY, F.FUND_VALUE, F.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, F.D_C_INDICATOR, F.AMOUNT, F.CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT, $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' THEN NVL(HCA.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' THEN NVL(APS.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'M' THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'O' AND (LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 OR (F.JE_SOURCE = 'Year End Close' AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 7)) THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'B' THEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID || F.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT
      ELSE NULL
    END AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID
  FROM FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES F
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, CUST_ACCOUNT_ID FROM apps.HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) HCA ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, VENDOR_ID FROM apps.AP_SUPPLIERS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) APS ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = APS.VENDOR_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE4 FROM apps.GL_JE_LINES WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) IN (4, 7)) GJL ON F.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID AND F.JE_LINE_NUM = GJL.JE_LINE_NUM
  WHERE F.PERIOD_YEAR IN ($[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_PSC_EXT])
),
cdc AS (
  SELECT F.CCID, F.JE_HEADER_ID, F.JE_LINE_NUM, F.PERIOD_NUM, F.PERIOD_YEAR, F.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, F.JE_SOURCE, F.JE_CATEGORY, F.FUND_VALUE, F.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, F.D_C_INDICATOR, F.AMOUNT, F.CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT, $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' THEN NVL(HCA.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' THEN NVL(APS.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'M' THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'O' AND (LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 OR (F.JE_SOURCE = 'Year End Close' AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 7)) THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'B' THEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID || F.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT
      ELSE NULL
    END AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID
  FROM FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES F
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, CUST_ACCOUNT_ID FROM apps.HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) HCA ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, VENDOR_ID FROM apps.AP_SUPPLIERS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) APS ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = APS.VENDOR_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE4 FROM apps.GL_JE_LINES WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) IN (4, 7)) GJL ON F.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID AND F.JE_LINE_NUM = GJL.JE_LINE_NUM
  WHERE F.PERIOD_YEAR IN ($[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_CDC_EXT])
),
ihs AS (
  SELECT F.CCID, F.JE_HEADER_ID, F.JE_LINE_NUM, F.PERIOD_NUM, F.PERIOD_YEAR, F.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, F.JE_SOURCE, F.JE_CATEGORY, F.FUND_VALUE, F.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, F.D_C_INDICATOR, F.AMOUNT, F.CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT, $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' THEN NVL(HCA.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' THEN NVL(APS.ATTRIBUTE1, CASE WHEN F.FED_NON_FED = 'F' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE4) = 7 AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE NULL END)
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'M' THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'O' AND (LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 4 OR (F.JE_SOURCE = 'Year End Close' AND LENGTH(GJL.ATTRIBUTE1) = 7)) THEN GJL.ATTRIBUTE1
      WHEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'B' THEN F.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID || F.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT
      ELSE NULL
    END AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID
  FROM FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES F
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, CUST_ACCOUNT_ID FROM apps.HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) HCA ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'C' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = HCA.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ATTRIBUTE1, VENDOR_ID FROM apps.AP_SUPPLIERS WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) = 4) APS ON F.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE = 'S' AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID IS NOT NULL AND F.TRADING_PARTNER_ID = APS.VENDOR_ID
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE4 FROM apps.GL_JE_LINES WHERE LENGTH(ATTRIBUTE1) IN (4, 7)) GJL ON F.JE_HEADER_ID = GJL.JE_HEADER_ID AND F.JE_LINE_NUM = GJL.JE_LINE_NUM
  WHERE F.PERIOD_YEAR IN ($[GTAS_FISCAL_YR_IHS_EXT])
),
base AS (
  SELECT * FROM fda
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM psc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM cdc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM ihs
)
SELECT B.CCID, B.JE_HEADER_ID, B.JE_LINE_NUM, B.PERIOD_NUM, B.PERIOD_YEAR, B.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, B.JE_SOURCE, B.JE_CATEGORY, B.FUND_VALUE, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.D_C_INDICATOR, B.AMOUNT, B.CREATED_ON_DT, B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID) = 7 AND SUBSTR(B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, 1, 3) <> '075' THEN (SELECT FFV.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFV WHERE FFV.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'HHS_TP_ELIMINATION_CODE' AND FFV.FLEX_VALUE = SUBSTR(B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, 2, 2))
    WHEN SUBSTR(B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, 1, 3) = '075' THEN (SELECT IHS.OPDIV FROM W_GTAS_INTRAHHS_D IHS WHERE IHS.TP_MAIN_ACT = SUBSTR(B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, 4, 4))
    ELSE (SELECT FFV.DESCRIPTION FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL FFV WHERE FFV.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'HHS_TP_ELIMINATION_CODE' AND FFV.FLEX_VALUE = B.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID)
  END AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME
FROM base B
